name: When should a first-time luxury home buyer start looking for properties?

mainEntity.name: When should a first-time luxury home buyer start looking for properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: A first-time luxury home buyer should ideally start looking for properties after securing pre-approval for financing and clearly defining their priorities, such as location preferences in Miami-Dade or Palm Beach County, desired amenities, and lifestyle needs. This preparation ensures you are ready to make a competitive offer when the right property becomes available. Kelby Contreras can help align your search with market availability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin looking for luxury properties after securing financing pre-approval and clearly defining your priorities, such as location and amenities.
